title: Nuclear Binding Energy
description: A nucleus weighs less than the protons and neutrons in it. The missing mass is the energy that binds them; millions of times more per atom than any chemical bond. The way into fission and fusion.

puzzle.goal: A nucleus of Z protons and A − Z neutrons weighs less than its parts did apart. Write the energy B that holds it together, from the proton mass m_p, the neutron mass m_n, the nucleus's mass M and the speed of light.
puzzle.name: Nuclear binding energy (mass defect)
puzzle.ask: Find B in MeV for helium-4, with masses in atomic mass units (1 u·c² = 931.494 MeV).
puzzle.method: Mass and energy are one: the mass that went missing when the nucleons came together left as energy, E = Δm c².
